finding: The asymmetric exact-retention candidate remains materially cheaper than full analytical constitutive evaluation in the optimized Fortran screen while F-AHL04C showed near-analytical nonlinear Richards response.
tradeoff: Exact retention gives up part of the maximum full-lookup speed gain but retains about 26.6 percent constitutive evaluation reduction in this screen.
nonclaims: This is not an end-to-end SWAP or Richards speedup.
The result is one material/fixture and requires broader material and trajectory qualification.
next_gate: Implement a genuinely optimized split research provider that computes theta analytically without first computing full analytical C/K, then run multi-material end-to-end Richards trajectory and total-cost qualification.
